title: GAM.AI: Edge AI & Universal Offline Intelligence Platform
description: Zero-dependency Edge AI platform and local-first universal assistant. Operates 100% air-gapped on under 120MB RAM or transitions seamlessly to Hybrid Online Intelligence with Wikipedia REST and DuckDuckGo Lite live web research. Features 3 tailored personas (General, Student, NetEng), multi-vendor network provisioning (Cisco, Huawei, FortiGate, MikroTik, Hikvision, OLT/ONT), continuous token safety, and cross-platform native binaries for Android, Linux, Windows, and Web PWA.

title: GAMA: Cybernetic Music & Frequency Audio Platform
description: Native Android audio streaming and frequency manipulation suite built with Jetpack Compose. Features trending music instant shuffle, relatable available playlists search across Spotify, YouTube Music and Apple Music with one-tap import, custom playlist creation & one-click playlist batch downloading, dynamic custom color accent picker, gesture & 3-button navigation auto-adaptation, and persistent background audio streaming with official YouTube IFrame bridge.

title: Enterprise Multi-Area OSPF Network Simulation
description: Engineered a redundant multi-area OSPF enterprise topology in Cisco Packet Tracer with dual ABRs, inter-VLAN trunking, redundant default routes, and secure access lists.

title: Hardened Nginx Reverse Proxy & Anycast DNS Integration
description: Architected a secure Linux web gateway with custom Nginx server blocks, HTTP/2 enforcement, SSL/TLS optimization, and Anycast-routed DNS zones across distributed global nodes.

title: Isolated Microservice Container Architecture
description: Designed isolated container environments utilizing customized Dockerfiles, persistent volumes, and bridge network namespaces for secure service execution.

title: Automated DNS Zone & Service Health Monitoring Pipeline
description: Implemented automated probe mechanisms and bash alerting scripts to audit domain records, name server latency, and HTTP endpoint availability in real-time.

title: Static Cloud Architecture & Distributed Web Delivery
description: Constructed an ultra-fast, serverless multi-page web platform utilizing pure semantic HTML5, CSS custom properties, and edge CDN distribution with custom domain SSL integration.

title: Subnetting Engine & IP Address Management Blueprint
description: Formulated a structured IPv4/IPv6 address allocation framework for scalable branch networks, minimizing broadcast domains and maximizing routing table efficiency.
